# Products Module — Full CRUD with Auto-Generated Codes

## Fields

- `code` — auto-generated: `"P" + String(nextId).padStart(6, "0")` (e.g. P000001). Computed on POST from max existing id + 1.
- `name` — required, unique
- `categoryId` — FK → categories.id (SearchableSelect in form)
- `brand` — optional text
- `model` — optional text
- `minStock` — decimal(10,4), default 0
- `stock` — decimal(10,4), default 0
- `lastCost` — decimal(10,4), default 0
- `avgCost` — decimal(10,4), default 0
- `status` — commonStatusEnum, default Active
- Audit fields: createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt, createdBy, updatedBy, deletedBy, deletedReason

## Auto-code generation (POST handler)

```ts
const [maxRow] = await db.select({ maxId: sql`COALESCE(MAX(id), 0)` }).from(products);
const code = `P${String(maxRow.maxId + 1).padStart(6, "0")}`;
```

Code is never sent from the client — server computes it. Unique by construction (max id + 1).

## Schema

```ts
export const products = pgTable("products", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  code: text("code").notNull().unique(),
  name: text("name").notNull().unique(),
  categoryId: integer("category_id").references(() => categories.id),
  brand: text("brand"),
  model: text("model"),
  minStock: decimal("min_stock", { precision: 10, scale: 4 }).notNull().default("0"),
  stock: decimal("stock", { precision: 10, scale: 4 }).notNull().default("0"),
  lastCost: decimal("last_cost", { precision: 10, scale: 4 }).notNull().default("0"),
  avgCost: decimal("avg_cost", { precision: 10, scale: 4 }).notNull().default("0"),
  status: commonStatusEnum("status").notNull().default("Active"),
  // audit fields (standard)
});
```

Note: needs `decimal` import from drizzle-orm/pg-core.

## Validation

- `productSchema`: name (required, unique), categoryId (optional int), brand (optional), model (optional), minStock/stock/lastCost/avgCost (optional, default 0)
- Code NOT in the schema — server-generated only

## API routes

- GET list: search by name/brand/model/code, filter by status + categoryId
- POST: auto-generate code, set createdBy
- GET one / PUT / DELETE / PATCH: standard with audit fields

## Components (5 files)

- Columns: `code`, `name`, `categoryName` (from join), `brand`, `model`, `stock`, `status`, `createdAt`, actions
- Form modal: name (required), categoryId (SearchableSelect), brand, model, minStock, stock, lastCost, avgCost
- Delete modal: with reason input
- Search modal: text search + status + category filter

## Pages (3 files)

- `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx` (requirePageRead + timezone), `[id]/page.tsx`
